summary: SHIP-007 LIVE-DISCHARGED via PR-E fix in F32 GEMV PTX kernel layout. PARITY-GATE passes on default path. apr bench reports 124.6 tok/s @ 128-tok decode on RTX 4090 with --features cuda — 4.15× over AC-SHIP1-007 30 tok/s floor.

root_cause.what_was_wrong: The F32 GEMV PTX kernel assumed weight matrix A is (K rows × N cols) row-major where A[i,j] is at offset i*N + j. But the standard ML weight convention (PyTorch/SafeTensors/GGUF/dequantized lm_head) stores weights as [output_dim, input_dim] row-major: A[i,j] at i*K + j (where i is output index, j is input index).
root_cause.symptom: Kernel read TRANSPOSED weights. Computed y[i] = sum_k(A[k, i] * x[k]) instead of y[i] = sum_k(A[i, k] * x[k]). Produced systematically anti-correlated logits (cos=-0.005 vs CPU).
root_cause.code_change: Replaced 'col_offset = block_id * 4 + row_stride iteration' with 'row_base = a_ptr + block_id * K * 4; thread iterates A[block_id, t*32+thread_id]' for proper [N,K] row-major access.
